body: The mailbox holds a card: the north stretch closed, no reopening date filled in. Behind it, a transport permit for the same stretch is stamped for a return trip never logged. The renewal line is signed in someone else's hand.
title: Closed until further notice
gloss: An indefinitely closed stretch and an unrenewed transport permit sit together, the renewal signed by someone else.
rival_reading: A transport permit for a farm delivery route can go unrenewed and a stretch closed for spraying just as easily; a missing log entry does not by itself show an evacuation order failed.

body: The mailbox holds a sealed sample jar, its field number redrawn over a smudged first attempt, beside a delivery receipt for drum containers to a rural address. The item line reads only 'treatment,' the quantity circled twice.
title: One field number, redrawn
gloss: A redrawn field number and a drum delivery marked only 'treatment' sit together, its quantity circled twice.
rival_reading: A sealed sample and a drum delivery could belong to an ordinary relief run during a road restriction; a vague item line and a circled quantity do not by themselves show a program.
